stage0009_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0009_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0009_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0009_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Command Center ～

stage0009_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Sergeant Sagara and the others should be
　leaving for the school trip about now.」

stage0009_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「According to the schedule, that's correct.」

stage0009_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Their destination is Okinawa...
　Did I mention I once lived there myself?」

stage0009_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テッサ$$
「At my father's wishes I attended a Japanese
　school. The other kids kept their distance,
　so I ended up transferring to the base school...」

stage0009_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm sorry.
　That wasn't something to bring up now.」

stage0009_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「No...
　Waiting on reports from a unit in the field
　is nothing but nerve-wracking.」

stage0009_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Let's use this time to review any issues.」

stage0009_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Why would a Russian terrorist group
　have information on 'her'...?」

stage0009_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's reasonable to assume data leaked from
　a former 《$$人革連$$》 research body.」

stage0009_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And the research continued, with 'her'
　marked as material for it...」

stage0009_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「But that's settled once we crush their
　research institute.」

stage0009_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Given the risk to the area and casualties,
　we had them carry out a surprise attack...」

stage0009_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「There's no doubting their skill.」

stage0009_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「After all, they, or rather, that unit...
　has fought us in $$ミスリル$$ time and again.」

stage0009_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「True.
　Not an opponent I like to recall.」

stage0009_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「...Captain, word just came in from Danger 1.」

stage0009_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The operation succeeded.
　They met some resistance, but the
　research facility was completely destroyed.」

stage0009_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Once we recover them, the mission's done.
　...Captain, why not get some rest?」

stage0009_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No... there's something on my mind...」

stage0009_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Major, now that the immediate threat's
　passed, shall we pull back $$千鳥かなめ$$'s escort?」

stage0009_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then his brief taste of student life ends here...」

stage0009_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$恭子$$
「Say cheese!
　Okinawa sunshine really is different!」

stage0009_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$恭子$$
「A bit later and we could've swum in the sea.」

stage0009_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana, with your figure,
　a bikini would suit you perfectly.」

stage0009_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$恭子$$
「All you've said is 'yeah'...
　It's a waste not to enjoy the school trip.」

stage0009_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「With this guy tailing me around,
　how am I supposed to enjoy it!」

stage0009_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$宗介$$
「We're merely carrying out our trash duty.」

stage0009_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$甲児$$
「Trash Duty Oath One,
　produce as little trash as possible.」

stage0009_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Trash Duty Oath Two,
　dispose of trash the same day.」

stage0009_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Trash Duty Oath Three,
　put trash in semi-transparent bags.」

stage0009_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ボス$$
「Trash Duty Oath $$フォウ$$,
　group bags by squad.」

stage0009_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「Trash Duty Oath Five,
　don't trouble hotel or facility staff.」

stage0009_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Trash Duty Oath Six,
　always keep things clean.」

stage0009_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$さやか$$
「Trash Duty Oath Seven,
　when in trouble, consult the class rep.」

stage0009_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$宗介$$
「As you can see, we understand our trash
　duty and strive to carry it out.」

stage0009_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll grant you that...
　But this is a school trip, so quit picking
　up trash and actually enjoy it!」

stage0009_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　Faithful execution of duty is my pleasure.」

stage0009_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$宗介$$
「For that reason, in case of emergency,
　I must always hold a position where I can
　take the class rep's orders.」

stage0009_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Fine, I'll concede that much...!
　But what's with dumping out every trash can
　in my path to collect its trash!」

stage0009_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「In case some hazardous item was placed inside.」

stage0009_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You're the hazardous person here!
　Now $$恭子$$ and I look just as suspicious!」

stage0009_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$l!
　Quit dumping out trash cans right along
　with him and do something about it!」

stage0009_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アルト$$
（It's because $$宗介$$ insisted a place
　like this is perfect for an attacker
　that things ended up like this...!）

stage0009_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Never thought even $n would agree that
　trash cans are ideal spots for a trap...）

stage0009_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$甲児$$
（Seriously, is that girl actually being
　targeted by something?）

stage0009_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$さやか$$
（$$ミスリル$$'s got her marked, so it's got to
　be true...）

stage0009_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway!
　If you cause any more trouble than this,
　Jindai High'll get banned outright!」

stage0009_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana, it's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　It's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!」

stage0009_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ボス$$
「What the heck is that!?
　A bear!? Or maybe a mouse!?」

stage0009_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No, $$ボス$$.
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$, $$ふもふもランド$$'s mascot.」

stage0009_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$さやか$$
「I'd heard the rumors, but he's really cute!」

stage0009_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But seriously... what animal is that?」

stage0009_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$恭子$$
「$$ボン太くん#robot$$ is just $$ボン太くん#robot$$.
　I bet he's telling Kana and Sagara
　to make up.」

stage0009_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Guess it can't be helped.
　Not if $$ボン太くん#robot$$ says so...」

stage0009_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$宗介$$
「If an attacker were hiding in there...」

stage0009_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$かなめ$$
「There's no one inside $$ボン太くん#robot$$!!」

stage0009_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$甲児$$
「She took off while you were seeing stars.」

stage0009_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　Then I must go after her at once.」

stage0009_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just give it a rest.
　Quit ruining that girl's school trip.」

stage0009_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, turns out that's not necessary anymore.」

stage0009_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sergeant $$クルツ$$...!
　What are you doing at $$ふもふもランド$$?」

stage0009_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$さやか$$
「And you're saying $$宗介$$'s duty is over...」

stage0009_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's exactly what I came here to tell you.」

stage0009_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Message from the Major.
　...The threat targeting $$千鳥かなめ$$'s
　been eliminated. Her escort duty ends here.」

stage0009_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Though $$ウルズ$$ 7 is to stay on the school trip.」

stage0009_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The trip's already paid for, so get your
　money's worth. Well... it's their classy way
　of letting you enjoy normal high school life.」

stage0009_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Very well.
　Everything is a learning experience.」

stage0009_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, I'll enjoy some Okinawa sun on leave.
　See ya.」

stage0009_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Okinawa sun, huh...
　Nice way to put picking up girls.」

stage0009_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アルト$$
「So, what now...?
　If $$宗介$$'s duty's over, that means
　we're out of a job too.」

stage0009_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ボス$$
「But thanks to $$宗介$$ nearly attacking
　$$ボン太くん#robot$$, we're all treated like suspects now.」

stage0009_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$甲児$$
「We came all the way to Okinawa,
　so it's gotta be the beach!」

stage0009_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$さやか$$
「Too early to swim, but a beautiful sea's
　nice just to look at.」

stage0009_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Though this beach has a fair bit of trash...」

stage0009_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Because that's my mission, assigned to trash duty.」

stage0009_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アルト$$
「Geez... serious in the weirdest places.」

stage0009_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アルト$$
「Alright...!
　Let's clean up the beach, trash duty style.」

stage0009_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Roger that.
　Trash doesn't suit a beautiful sea like this.」

stage0009_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well then, acting Skull Leader... lead the way.」

stage0009_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$甲児$$ and $$さやか$$ take the right block,
　$$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$ take the left...」

stage0009_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n handle hazard recovery,
　$$ミシェル$$ and I haul the trash to the dump.」

stage0009_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$風間$$
「Um... mind if I help too?」

stage0009_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$風間$$
「I owe Sagara for helping me out,
　and there's a lot I want to talk about.」

stage0009_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Huh... $$風間$$, into that sort of thing?」

stage0009_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah.
　Not just AS, Mobile Suits, ATs,
　Valkyries, super robots too are my territory.」

stage0009_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$風間$$
「That's why 《$$映画『ソレスタルビーイング』$$》
　was unbearable.」

stage0009_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$さやか$$
「It's the movie everyone's talking about.
　It depicts the $$破界事変$$ and Regeneration
　War, centered on Celestial Being and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

stage0009_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Celestial Being and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ fighting
　the villainous $$アロウズ$$...
　Quite the thrilling action blockbuster.」

stage0009_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$風間$$
「But really, it's basically propaganda
　the Earth Federation Government made
　to erase its bad image from the past.」

stage0009_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, yeah...
　Since it's not a documentary, the cast
　are actors, so some exaggeration's normal...」

stage0009_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$甲児$$
「I was surprised too, watching it.
　The Gundam Meisters turned into a hero,
　glasses guy, cutie, and power fighter...」

stage0009_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ボス$$
「And on top of that, the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ was
　a total super robot too.」

stage0009_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$風間$$
「I can't forgive that kind of cheap kiddie stuff!」

stage0009_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$風間$$
「Celestial Being pioneered GN Drive mobile
　suits, and their Gundams
　got portrayed like that...!」

stage0009_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$風間$$
「Not just the Gundams either!
　$$マジンガーＺ$$, only about 20 meters tall,
　became a 200-meter giant of light!」

stage0009_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$甲児$$
「That part actually moved me a little...」

stage0009_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$風間$$
「The VF-25 got butchered too!
　They filmed it in a costume suit,
　so only Battroid mode ever showed up!」

stage0009_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$風間$$
「And lumping the F, S, and G types
　all together like that...
　it's basically blasphemy against the VF line!」

stage0009_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even I couldn't forgive that one!」

stage0009_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$風間$$
「You really get it, Kabuto, Saotome...!」

stage0009_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$風間$$
「So, is that the kind of talk you always
　get into with Sagara?」

stage0009_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$風間$$
「I see...
　You two stand out, but I never saw you
　talking much with others, so...」

stage0009_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess this is the first real talk we've had, $$風間$$.」

stage0009_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah.
　But there are plenty of others besides me
　who'd like to talk to you guys too.」

stage0009_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$風間$$
「Saotome and $$ミシェル$$ are popular with the girls, too.」

stage0009_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アルト$$
「I see...
　Maybe we're the ones who built a wall
　around ourselves.」

stage0009_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$風間$$
「Um... mind if I help too?」

stage0009_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$風間$$
「I owe Sagara for helping me out,
　and there's a lot I want to talk about.」

stage0009_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Huh... $$風間$$, into that sort of thing?」

stage0009_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah.
　Not just AS, Mobile Suits, ATs,
　Valkyries, super robots too are my territory.」

stage0009_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$風間$$
「That's why 《$$映画『ソレスタルビーイング』$$》
　was unbearable.」

stage0009_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Right?!
　No matter how you look at it, that was too much!」

stage0009_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$風間$$
「You really get it, Kabuto, Saotome...!」

stage0009_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$風間$$
「So, is that the kind of talk you always
　get into with Sagara?」

stage0009_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$風間$$
「I see...
　You two stand out, but I never saw you
　talking much with others, so...」

stage0009_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess this is the first real talk we've had, $$風間$$.」

stage0009_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah.
　But there are plenty of others besides me
　who'd like to talk to you guys too.」

stage0009_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$風間$$
「Saotome and $$ミシェル$$ are popular with the girls, too.」

stage0009_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アルト$$
「I see...
　Maybe we're the ones who built a wall
　around ourselves.」

stage0009_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$n
「Once this trip's over, are you going back to $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0009_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's probably how it will be.」

stage0009_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$n
「Do you have no intention of staying at Jindai High?」

stage0009_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm different from $$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$.
　I attended school as a mission.」

stage0009_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$n
「$$アルト$$ and the others plan to keep balancing
　school life and the fighting, you know.」

stage0009_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$n
「...That was none of my business.
　Forget what I said earlier.」

stage0009_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Isn't it you who has lingering feelings
　about student life?」

stage0009_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know what you're fighting for,
　and I don't intend to ask.」

stage0009_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$宗介$$
「But now that you have the $$ジェニオン$$,
　if you want to fight that badly,
　is there any point in a high school life?」

stage0009_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$n
（$$宗介$$'s right...
　Deep down, I'm afraid...）

stage0009_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0009_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0009_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0009_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0009_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Captain $$オットー$$, did you read the report
　on that matter we discussed?」

stage0009_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$オットー$$
「Y-yes....
　It's hard to believe right away, but...」

stage0009_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But it's true.
　$$ミスリル$$ has already confirmed their existence
　and apparently has some in protective custody.」

stage0009_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$オットー$$
「I'm a person of 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, but
　to think 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 had people like that
　existing there too...」

stage0009_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「According to $$ミスリル$$'s research, candidates
　exist among $$ＵＣＷ$$'s people as well.」

stage0009_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$オットー$$
「Across parallel worlds, huh....
　That's even harder to believe...」

stage0009_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The existence of people with that ability is
　top secret; even among operation participants,
　only field officers and above know the details.」

stage0009_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even $$ミスリル$$'s request for cooperation here
　in the Far East is all to protect her, I'd wager.」

stage0009_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$ウィスパード$$....
　Handled wrong, that could turn the world upside down.」

stage0009_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$オットー$$
「Still, we already crushed that research
　institute, so I suppose we can rest easy...」

stage0009_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, we've confirmed an unidentified unit
　deploying along Codename Angel's return route.」

stage0009_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It's likely the same organization that's been
　repeatedly attacking $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0009_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$オットー$$
「So, leaderless, they threw a desperate last strike...」

stage0009_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$オットー$$
「Too bad for them, but call up the student group too.
　Crush them and finish this mission completely.」

stage0009_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Everyone aboard....
　I'm now in command here, in the captain's place.」

stage0009_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Due to unavoidable circumstances,
　this plane has landed at an air base in Hanka.」

stage0009_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Hanka Autonomous Region's a dictatorship,
　not even part of the Earth Federation...!?」

stage0009_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$詩織$$
「W-why are we landing somewhere like that...!?」

stage0009_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$恵理$$
「What is the meaning of this!?
　I never heard anything about this!」

stage0009_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「All of you will be taken hostage, fitting for
　this thrilling land under such complex politics.
　Please, look outside your window.」

stage0009_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$風間$$
「T-that's... an $$Ｒｋ－９２　サベージ$$...!
　And it's fully armed!」

stage0009_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「They say they'll welcome you all.
　However, if you attempt to flee or make any
　suspicious moves, we'll shoot you without hesitation.」

stage0009_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I mean you.
　The pretty young lady with the long hair.」

stage0009_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I want to make some footage to send the press.
　I'd like you to appear in it...
　I think you'd make good material...」

stage0009_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No, no, someone like me...
　as you can see, I'm just a scrawny little girl.
　I'd only make the viewers uncomfortable, really.」

stage0009_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Just come along, all right?
　Come on, no need to be shy.」

stage0009_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Let go!
　I said no!
　Why me!?」

stage0009_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$恵理$$
「What are you planning to do with my student!?」

stage0009_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Relax, I'll return her right away.」

stage0009_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$恵理$$
「No, I won't allow it!
　If you're taking someone, take me instead!」

stage0009_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You wouldn't do, I'm afraid.
　This is for the press's...」

stage0009_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$恵理$$
「That excuse won't fly, you coward!」

stage0009_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$恵理$$
「What kind of people are you!
　Hijacking a plane is despicable enough!
　And using children on top of it!」

stage0009_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$恵理$$
「Your claims are worth as much as scrap paper!
　No matter what reason you have, God would never
　allow this, ever...」

stage0009_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Sheesh....
　You're a noisy one, aren't you...」

stage0009_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Then I'll have you serve as an example, instead.」

stage0009_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Eh, forget it....
　You've killed the mood.」

stage0009_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But you, young lady... you're coming with me.」

stage0009_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You can resist if you want.
　...Though that's only if you want to taste
　that thrill from before one more time.」

stage0009_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I like a girl who listens.
　Now then, let's go.」

stage0009_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$風間$$
「What's going to happen to us...」

stage0009_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$デュオ$$
（You were seriously losing your composure back there.
　Sergeant $$相良宗介$$... or should I say $$ウルズ$$ 7?）

stage0009_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$デュオ$$
（Don't worry.
　Me and that guy from before are on your side.）

stage0009_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're fired up, $n.
　I suppose you're worried about your schoolmates?」

stage0009_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying...!
　Miss $$スズネ$$ and I are also your mental
　trainers, you know!」

stage0009_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's why I'll be paying the utmost
　attention to $n's mental state.」

stage0009_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I fully understand it's unpleasant to have
　'heart' preached at you by a robot like me.」

stage0009_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, please listen.
　In the battles ahead, $n's feelings
　will carry great meaning.」

stage0009_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Isn't it exactly when trying to protect
　something that $n shows his true worth...
　clear from every battle so far?」

stage0009_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure the $$ジェニオン$$ will answer those feelings.
　That's the kind of machine it is.」

stage0009_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right! So $n can fight with everything
　he's got, I'll work hard too!
　Today, let's get fired up... business, business!」
